name: Terriermon
main_effect: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When effects place Digimon cards with the [CS] trait in this Digimon's digivolution cards, if you have 1 or fewer Tamers, you may play 1 Tamer card with the [CS] trait from your hand without paying the cost.
source_effect: [Main] [Once Per Turn] By placing this [CS] trait Digimon's top stacked card as its bottom digivolution card, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.)
